profileIds.title: Profile IDs (visit-only mode)
profileIds.description: When set, skip the listing crawl entirely and visit only these profile detail pages (full description, website, phone, LinkedIn, Vimeo). Use to enrich rows that already passed classification.

targets.title: Targets
targets.description: List of {categorySlug, locationPath, metroKey} objects. categorySlug e.g. 'commercial-production-companies'; locationPath e.g. 'us/california/los-angeles' (empty string = category-wide, all locations); metroKey is your own label stamped on each record.

maxPagesPerList.title: Max Pages Per List
maxPagesPerList.description: Cap on paginated listing pages crawled per target (~21 profiles per page).

radius.title: Radius (miles)
radius.description: Search radius around the location, in miles. ProductionHUB's own default is 100.

visitProfiles.title: Visit Profile Pages
visitProfiles.description: Visit each profile detail page for the full (untruncated) description — the only place a website URL can be found. Adds one page load per profile.

testMode.title: Test Mode
testMode.description: Crawl only 1 listing page per target and at most 5 profile visits. Use to verify the actor quickly.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify proxy settings. Residential proxy recommended for cloud runs — Cloudflare scores datacenter IPs harshly.
